title: Prevention of coronal discoloration induced by regenerative endodontic treatment in an ex vivo model
authors: Shokouhinejad N, Khoshkhounejad M, Alikhasi M, Bagheri P, Camilleri J. 2018. Clin Oral Investig. ; 22(4):1725-1731. [Epub 2017]. * Study refers to Bone Protect fleece (Dentegris), which is a private label of Jason® fleece
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Sealing the pulp chamber walls before insertion of TAP decreased coronal discoloration following REP using different endodontic cements but did not prevent it” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
